conditions.kmesh: Gamma-centred 1x1x1 and 2x2x2 for representatives; experimental Na2MoO4 1x1x1

source_hash_scope: Current source while generating this report; these are not claimed as compiled-binary source hashes at the earlier measurement times.
interpretation: Completed response assembly does not imply a stationary or mechanically stable input crystal.
Six ideal archetypes are specified representatives; only Na2MoO4 uses the pinned experimental COD structure.
Static relaxed-ion response is absent when atomic stationarity or internal stability is not satisfied.
Gamma and 2x2x2 sampling differ substantially in some materials; these values are execution diagnostics rather than converged experimental predictions.
The initial cold-start survey was interrupted while relaxing LiF; its incomplete LiF relaxation was not recorded as converged. Later warm-start executions remain distinct optimizer records.
The finite-volume EOS fit and the analytic local bulk modulus require volume-window, image-cutoff and k-mesh convergence before comparing physical predictions.
